name: SLA Guard - Website Uptime and Claim Drafts

nodes.name: Authenticated Webhook
nodes.notes: Select a separate Header Auth credential: X-SLA-Key = a long random secret. Production URL: /webhook/sla-guard. Never use the Supabase key as this secret.

nodes.name: Settings and Request
nodes.notes: Only configuration in this workflow: Supabase Project URL and service ID. Contract, target URL, timeout and fee live in sg_services.

nodes.name: Route Action
nodes.notes: Outputs: 0 check; 1 status; 2 report; 3 invalid request.

nodes.name: Load Service
nodes.notes: Select SLA Guard - Supabase Header Auth (apikey). Empty results deliberately reach Start Probe, which explains the missing configuration.

nodes.name: Probe Website
nodes.notes: Only this node continues on error: HTTP failures, DNS failures and timeouts become down samples. No retries; redirects are not followed. Use a small unauthenticated /health response.

nodes.name: Save Check
nodes.notes: Select the SLA Guard - Supabase Header Auth credential (header: apikey). Database failures stop the execution; they never become website outages.

nodes.notes: Select the SLA Guard - Supabase Header Auth credential (header: apikey). Database failures stop the execution; they never become website outages.

parameters.content:
## SLA Guard | Website availability
1. Run supabase/schema.sql.
2. Edit Settings and Request (Project URL).
3. Select Supabase Header Auth on all 4 database HTTP nodes.
4. Select a SEPARATE Header Auth on Authenticated Webhook.
5. Execute Manual Check, then publish.
See README.md for Docker, Cloudflare and demo instructions.

## Check evidence
Every minute or authenticated POST {"action":"check"}.
Exact expected status = up. Other statuses/transport errors = down.
Save Check is idempotent per execution ID.
Database errors fail visibly and leave a monitoring gap.
Contract / endpoint / timeout: Supabase sg_services.

## Reports and API
POST /webhook/sla-guard with X-SLA-Key and JSON.
{"action":"status"}
{"action":"report","month":"YYYY-MM","dataset":"live"}
Omit month for previous UTC month; demo uses separate evidence.
Reports + claim text are stored in sg_reports. Human review required.
Unknown intervals block credit calculation. No automatic claim submission.
